missable_note: Only one trophy may be missable: Positive Mental Attitude. The first meditation spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is gone after that chapter; do it to be safe. Everything else — story trophies included — cannot be missed, and there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission.
online: None — all 55 trophies are single-player and offline.
playthroughs: 1 — free roam after the story, no New Game+, no difficulty settings.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (difficulty, time, missables)

stages.summary: Play the five chapters and take optional missions as they appear. Meditate at the Chapter 1 home spot (the one possibly missable trophy), scan vehicles and study animals on the way.
stages.title: 1 · Play the story

stages.summary: After the credits, work through the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion): 70 of the 80 challenges, 250 of 397 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 5 of 8 bank vaults, 3 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations and the rest.
stages.title: 2 · After the credits — the 100% checklist

stages.summary: Finish the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands and the side-character quests (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), then mop up whatever is left: collectibles, races and the cryptic hidden trophies.
